title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi grows anxious about being spotted by Pandian as everyone watches the film eagerly. Meanwhile, Cheran stands up to the goons who trouble him for being with Chandayatha.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Incited by Malar and Mathi, Revathi cleverly tricks Thangaraj into approving a maid for household chores. Later, Mathi happily shares the news of getting the job.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam submits proof exposing Chithra and Eshwari for medicine tampering. Police arrest them, clearing Nesan and Sethupathi as Savithri and Thamarai rejoice.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun grows suspicious as Aadhavan returns from Pooja's room after a secret visit. Later, Pooja takes charge of cooking and impresses the family with her delicious dishes.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Shanmugam and Abhi sneak away to get registered. Indhira confides in Murugan, but Inba and Iniya overhear and expose the secret to a shocked Kandhasamy and Lakshmi.

title: Pandian Stores 2
episodeTitle: Senthil Makes a Promise to Meena
description: Thangamayil vents her sorrows. Later, Sakthivel agrees to attend Pandian's anniversary, while Senthil promises Meena he will quit drinking after an honest conversation.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Ravi, Vijaya, and Annamalai rejoice over Shruthi's pregnancy. Meanwhile, Vijaya scolds Sudha, and Muthu tells Meena about Sathya's taunt on his lack of education.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri proposes to Abinaya with a creative rangoli and pleads for her forgiveness. She takes him to his hut and reveals the real reason for her anger, leaving him shattered.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Thennavan gifts Senthamizh a mobile phone for their late-night conversations. He tells Pandian he plans to win her love to avenge Manjamalai's family.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman's new look convinces people he has changed, earning support in the election campaign. Later, Sidharth's plot provokes him, exposing his unchanged rough nature.
